about.title: About Hotels Vendors
about.subtitle: Building the Future of Hospitality Procurement
about.heroDescription: Founded in 2024, Hotels Vendors was born from a simple observation: Egyptian hotels spend too much time and money on procurement. We're here to change that.
about.description: Hotels Venders is Egypt's leading digital procurement platform, connecting hotels with verified suppliers to streamline purchasing and reduce costs.

features.title: Verified Supplier Network
features.description: Every supplier on our platform is thoroughly vetted for quality, reliability, and compliance with Egyptian hospitality standards.

features.title: Smart Procurement

features.title: Real-Time Tracking
features.description: Track orders from placement to delivery with full visibility into every step of the process.

features.title: ETA Compliance
features.description: Built-in Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoicing ensures your invoices are always compliant.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Transparent Pricing for Every Business Size
pricing.heroDescription: Choose the plan that fits your business. All plans include access to our verified supplier network and core procurement tools.
pricing.description: Flexible pricing plans designed for hotels and suppliers of all sizes.

faqs.question: Is there a setup fee?
faqs.answer: No setup fees for any plan. You can get started immediately after registration.

faqs.question: Can I switch plans later?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle.

faqs.question: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
faqs.answer: Yes, annual billing includes a 20% discount compared to monthly billing.

pricing.ctaTitle: Not Sure Which Plan is Right?
pricing.ctaDescription: Our team can help you find the perfect fit for your business.
pricing.metaDescription: Explore transparent pricing plans for Hotels Vendors. Free Starter plan available. Professional and Enterprise plans for growing operations.
